title: STARTEX: EHR Downtime — Paper Charts Initiated

fields.location: Ottawa River Regional Medical Center, Toledo, Lucas County, Ohio
fields.load: Census: 331 inpatients; 21 ED patients; 9 scheduled surgical cases; 11 outpatients at Dialysis Center
fields.staffing: Night shift handing over to day shift; full nursing and medical coverage
fields.narration: STARTEX. This is an exercise. It is 05:40 AM on Tuesday, March 3, 2026, at Ottawa River Regional Medical Center. The CareLine EHR has not responded on any unit since 05:31. The night nursing supervisor has called IT on-call. Power, water, medical gas, and telephony are normal. The downtime viewer BCA-VIEW01 last refreshed at 05:15. Downtime has not been declared.

status.name: ED and Inpatient Units
status.note: No EHR access; paper charting in progress

status.name: Outpatient Dialysis Center
status.note: Scheduled 11 patients; waiting for EHR to restore

fields.facilitatorNote: Confirm all roles have the EHR Downtime Procedures Annex (ORRMC-DT-ANX-2026) and the EOP (ORRMC-EOP-2026). The AOC must declare downtime within 10 minutes of the first report.
fields.scenarioTitle: Paper Charts — EHR Downtime and Trust in the Record

instructorNote: This inject establishes the baseline for a ransomware-induced EHR downtime. The AOC must act quickly to declare downtime and activate HCC. Watch for delays in declaring Level 2 or 1, or attempts to restore EHR without HCC activation.
